definitions.explanation: Physically wide or having a large width.
Covering a large range or variety of things. Used figuratively for knowledge, interests, activities, etc.

examples.japanese: {幅広|はばひろ}い⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幅広|はばひろ}くて⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧やすい。
examples.english: This road is wide and easy to walk on.

examples.japanese: {幅広|はばひろ}い⟦{年齢層|ねんれいそう}→年齢層：25966_nenreisou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It is popular among a wide range of age groups.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幅広|はばひろ}い⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていて→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ついていける→ついていく：10991_tsuiteiku⟧。
examples.english: She has broad knowledge and can keep up with any topic.

notes:
{幅広|はばひろ}い is an i-adjective. The figurative sense (wide-ranging) is more common than the physical sense.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {幅広|はばひろ}く
- Noun modifier: {幅広|はばひろ}い + noun

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幅広|はばひろ}い⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧: broad knowledge
- {幅広|はばひろ}い⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧: wide range of fields
- {幅広|はばひろ}い⟦{年齢層|ねんれいそう}→年齢層：25966_nenreisou⟧: wide age range
- {幅広|はばひろ}く⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: to be active in a wide range of areas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧: wide, spacious (general)
- {幅広|はばひろ}い: emphasizes range or variety, often figurative
